audience: practice managers who look up physicians, practices and visit types in Elation Health

useCases.title: List the physicians and their specialties
useCases.text: The AI lists the practice's physicians with NPI, specialty, credentials, license and practice. You get a clear staff overview.

useCases.title: Check the practices and service locations you can access
useCases.text: The AI lists the practices of the API key with address, status, time zone, physicians and service locations.

useCases.title: See which appointment types the practice offers
useCases.text: The AI lists the appointment types, the visit reasons, with the default duration of each. You can compare visit lengths.
